Third-party libraries shipped with S-Market Place (kept as local files so the site does not depend on another server):

jsQR 1.4.0  - reads a QR code from a camera picture.   Licence: Apache-2.0   https://github.com/cozmo/jsQR
qrcode-generator 2.0.4 - draws a QR code.               Licence: MIT          https://github.com/kazuhikoarase/qrcode-generator
